description: Every arithmetic term strongly represents its natural-number value in \(Q\), using equality with the distinguished output variable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.term_stronglyRepresents {n : ℕ}
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term (Fin n)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents
    (fun x => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize x t)
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.termGraph t)
